import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/customer_segments.csv')

# Set style
plt.style.use('seaborn-v0_8-darkgrid')
sns.set_palette("husl")

# Create figure with subplots
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(20, 16))

# 1. Income distribution by education level
ax1 = plt.subplot(3, 3, 1)
sns.boxplot(data=df, x='Education', y='Income', order=sorted(df['Education'].unique()))
ax1.set_title('Income Distribution by Education Level', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_xlabel('Education Level', fontsize=12)
ax1.set_ylabel('Income ($)', fontsize=12)
ax1.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)

# 2. Spending categories comparison
spending_cols = ['MntWines', 'MntFruits', 'MntMeatProducts', 'MntFishProducts', 
                 'MntSweetProducts', 'MntGoldProds']
spending_totals = df[spending_cols].sum()
spending_labels = ['Wines', 'Fruits', 'Meat', 'Fish', 'Sweets', 'Gold']

ax2 = plt.subplot(3, 3, 2)
bars = ax2.bar(range(len(spending_totals)), spending_totals.values, color=plt.cm.Set3(np.arange(len(spending_totals))))
ax2.set_title('Total Spending by Product Category', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_xlabel('Product Category', fontsize=12)
ax2.set_ylabel('Total Amount Spent', fontsize=12)
ax2.set_xticks(range(len(spending_totals)))
ax2.set_xticklabels(spending_labels, rotation=45, ha='right')

# Add value labels on bars
for bar in bars:
    height = bar.get_height()
    ax2.text(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width()/2., height,
             f'{int(height):,}', ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=10)

# 3. Purchase channels comparison
purchase_cols = ['NumWebPurchases', 'NumCatalogPurchases', 'NumStorePurchases']
purchase_totals = df[purchase_cols].sum()
purchase_labels = ['Web', 'Catalog', 'Store']

ax3 = plt.subplot(3, 3, 3)
wedges, texts, autotexts = ax3.pie(purchase_totals.values, labels=purchase_labels, autopct='%1.1f%%',
                                    startangle=90, colors=plt.cm.Pastel1(np.arange(len(purchase_totals))))
ax3.set_title('Purchase Distribution by Channel', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
for autotext in autotexts:
    autotext.set_color('black')
    autotext.set_fontweight('bold')

# 4. Customer demographics: Marital status distribution
ax4 = plt.subplot(3, 3, 4)
marital_counts = df['Marital_Status'].value_counts()
bars = ax4.bar(range(len(marital_counts)), marital_counts.values, color=plt.cm.tab20c(np.arange(len(marital_counts))))
ax4.set_title('Customer Distribution by Marital Status', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_xlabel('Marital Status', fontsize=12)
ax4.set_ylabel('Number of Customers', fontsize=12)
ax4.set_xticks(range(len(marital_counts)))
ax4.set_xticklabels(marital_counts.index, rotation=45, ha='right')

# Add value labels on bars
for bar in bars:
    height = bar.get_height()
    ax4.text(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width()/2., height,
             f'{int(height)}', ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=10)

# 5. Age distribution (calculated from Year_Birth)
df['Age'] = 2024 - df['Year_Birth']  # Assuming current year is 2024

ax5 = plt.subplot(3, 3, 5)
sns.histplot(data=df, x='Age', bins=20, kde=True, color='skyblue')
ax5.set_title('Customer Age Distribution', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax5.set_xlabel('Age', fontsize=12)
ax5.set_ylabel('Number of Customers', fontsize=12)

# 6. Income vs Total Spending correlation
df['Total_Spending'] = df[spending_cols].sum(axis=1)

ax6 = plt.subplot(3, 3, 6)
scatter = ax6.scatter(df['Income'], df['Total_Spending'], alpha=0.6, c=df['Age'], cmap='viridis', s=30)
ax6.set_title('Income vs Total Spending', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax6.set_xlabel('Income ($)', fontsize=12)
ax6.set_ylabel('Total Spending', fontsize=12)

# Add colorbar for age
cbar = plt.colorbar(scatter, ax=ax6)
cbar.set_label('Age', fontsize=12)

# 7. Campaign acceptance rates
campaign_cols = ['AcceptedCmp1', 'AcceptedCmp2', 'AcceptedCmp3', 'AcceptedCmp4', 'AcceptedCmp5', 'Response']
campaign_names = ['Campaign 1', 'Campaign 2', 'Campaign 3', 'Campaign 4', 'Campaign 5', 'Latest Campaign']
acceptance_rates = df[campaign_cols].mean() * 100

ax7 = plt.subplot(3, 3, 7)
bars = ax7.bar(range(len(acceptance_rates)), acceptance_rates.values, color=plt.cm.Set2(np.arange(len(acceptance_rates))))
ax7.set_title('Campaign Acceptance Rates', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax7.set_xlabel('Campaign', fontsize=12)
ax7.set_ylabel('Acceptance Rate (%)', fontsize=12)
ax7.set_xticks(range(len(acceptance_rates)))
ax7.set_xticklabels(campaign_names, rotation=45, ha='right')
ax7.set_ylim(0, max(acceptance_rates.values) * 1.2)

# Add value labels on bars
for bar in bars:
    height = bar.get_height()
    ax7.text(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width()/2., height,
             f'{height:.1f}%', ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=10)

# 8. Household composition
df['Total_Children'] = df['Kidhome'] + df['Teenhome']
household_counts = df['Total_Children'].value_counts().sort_index()

ax8 = plt.subplot(3, 3, 8)
bars = ax8.bar(household_counts.index, household_counts.values, color='lightcoral')
ax8.set_title('Household Composition (Number of Children)', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax8.set_xlabel('Number of Children', fontsize=12)
ax8.set_ylabel('Number of Customers', fontsize=12)

# Add value labels on bars
for x, y in zip(household_counts.index, household_counts.values):
    ax8.text(x, y, f'{y}', ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=10)

# 9. Recency distribution (days since last purchase)
ax9 = plt.subplot(3, 3, 9)
sns.histplot(data=df, x='Recency', bins=20, kde=True, color='mediumseagreen')
ax9.set_title('Days Since Last Purchase', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax9.set_xlabel('Recency (Days)', fontsize=12)
ax9.set_ylabel('Number of Customers', fontsize=12)

# Adjust layout and save
plt.suptitle('Customer Segmentation Analysis Dashboard', fontsize=18, fontweight='bold', y=1.02)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150, facecolor='white')
plt.close()
